title: FALSIFY-FLOW-011 cannot tell cop-minted from agent-filed issues by author: every session files as noahgift
evidence: gh issue list -R paiml/aprender --state all --limit 1000 --json author -> noahgift 977, alfredodeza 22, guyernest 1; the cop and every agent session share the noahgift token, so 'authored by a non-cop agent session' has no observable author
repro: gh issue list -R paiml/aprender --state all --limit 1000 --json author --jq '[.[].author.login]|group_by(.)|map({(.[0]):length})|add'
